description_original: The Apple USB-C-to-USB Adapter lets you connect iOS devices and many of your USB accessories to a MacBook with a USB-C port. Plug the USB-C end of the adapter into the USB-C port on your MacBook, and then connect your flash drive, camera or other standard USB device.
description_official_dataset: Designed for use with Apple MacBook® with a USB-C port; connect your iOS devices and USB accessories to your compatible MacBook; sync and charge your Apple iPhone®, iPad® or iPod® (USB cable not included)
